about: Calibration of the vanilla embark UI for steps.lua. Values marked CALIBRATE come from Run 5/6 (window 1716x1000 px, tiles 10x15 px) and must be re-measured at live slot L0 (README: Calibration).
calibrate: world_click: percent of the window; closed loop corrects the tile, the click only has to land on the map

local_tile_px/local_k (live L0, 1716x1000): placing rectangle min = cam_local + k + floor((held px - window centre px) / 16); BUG-247: one fixed held pixel, the camera moves, k measured once (|k| <= local_k_max), the second miss fails
hover_k (BUG-247, scan --hover): hovered tile = cam_local + hover_k + floor((held px - centre px) / 16); intro_polls (BUG-246): polls fort.intro looks for the intro popup
citizens: [x, y0, dy] tile of dwarf 0 in the Prepare carefully list and rows per dwarf (startdwarf.lua: 3 rows, list at x=5 y=9)
tabs: tab labels on Prepare carefully
buy.dx: column offset from the item name to the clickable +1 control (abs_x: fixed column instead)

load (K2, loadsave.lua): tries = clicks before 'not done'; timeout_ms = the click phase; settle_ms = wait after a click before the screen is judged (a second click only goes out when the screen did not change); stale = identical screens in a row that end the run; unknown_polls = polls on a title screen with neither the main menu nor the save before the run says so
